cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I said the evening would flow, I was plainly describing this kitchen flood. You may stop looking surprised.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You meant the conversation would flow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And what are we talking about? Water. Put that beside my original words before you dispute the forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe. Help me turn the water off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You take the valve; I'll clear the doorway. Once it stops flowing, you can tell me which part of my description was inaccurate.

reason: Keep flow as the established prediction throughout; B practical valve request lets A assign repair roles while demanding retrospective vindication, avoiding new prior open-up words.
